title: SHA-pin all GitHub Actions (13 workflows)
description:
把 .github/workflows/*.yml 中所有 3rd-party action 引用改为 commit SHA 钉版 + tag 注释, 禁止 @v4 / @main 形式.

Cindy 参考: `actions/checkout@3d3c42e5...v7.0.1` (SHA + 注释保留可读性).
覆盖 13 workflows: ci / cleanup-merged / cli-rule-ci / coverage-gate / dual-engine / kallax-ci / perf-baseline / pr-body-check / pr-reviewer-check / pr-size-check / release / rust-build / rust-test.
acceptance: 所有 uses: <owner>/<action>@<40-hex-sha> # v<ver>  格式
CI 全绿 (13 workflows 全 pass)

notes: Branch/moving-tag refs (dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable, ludeeus/action-shellcheck@master) resolved to current commit SHA with '@ 2026-07-26' comment for readability of drift window.
taiki-e/install-action@cargo-deny is a lightweight tag ref that gets updated per release; pinned to current commit with 'cargo-deny' comment.
cargo-audit.yml was in .github/workflows/ scope (14th workflow); its pre-existing '# TODO: 136-A pin' marker was removed after applying the SHA.
pr-reviewer-check.yml contains no third-party action uses.
